title: Maximum difference in an array
prompt: Specification: Given a non-empty array and its length n, return the difference between its largest and smallest elements. Four candidate implementations follow. Which candidate satisfies the specification for all valid inputs? Select one candidate.

evidence.title: Candidate executions against the test suite
evidence.body:
Each candidate was executed against the same test suite.

Test 1: assert max_Abs_Diff((2,1,5,3),4) == 4
Test 2: assert max_Abs_Diff((9,3,2,5,1),5) == 8
Test 3: assert max_Abs_Diff((3,2,1),3) == 2
